note: Stock capacities reuse satk KB facts and mod-check stores. Supplemental entries contain numbers, symbol names and addresses only. Configuration declarations and INI suggestions do not prove runtime hooks; an unspecified adjuster maximum is not an unlimited guarantee.

fastman92.ref: fastman92 Limit Adjuster, GTASA INI sections and option names
fastman92.note: Version-dependent; review ID LIMITS activation and other prerequisite patches in the installed version.

ola.note: Option names and MiB units checked against the archived upstream configuration; MemoryAvailable is capped at 2048 MiB.

limits.title: Model ID address space (highest ID + 1)
limits.advice: Rebase streaming resource IDs with fastman92; a free model ID alone does not enlarge a model-type store.

limits.title: Vehicle model infos
limits.advice: Vehicle IDs outside 400-611 also need the adjuster's handling and vehicle audio features.

limits.title: Object model infos (atomic + damageable)
limits.advice: Raise the atomic and damageable stores separately; their free slots are not interchangeable.

limits.title: IDE 2DFX store
limits.advice: Put effects in validated DFF 2DFX extensions; those do not consume the IDE effect store.

limits.title: DFF 2DFX records
limits.advice: Inventory only; lights, entry-exits and other effects have separate runtime pools.

limits.title: Streaming COL archives (including generic slot)
limits.advice: Merge collision archives when possible; this is separate from the ColModels pool.

limits.title: Ordinary TXD names (main/loose files and IDE chains)
Streaming animation archives
limits.advice: Only main-streaming IFPs consume these slots; cutscene ANIM/CUTS archives are separate.

limits.title: Streaming IMG archive slots (main + player)
limits.ref: CStreaming::ms_files; CClothes::Init registers PLAYER.IMG; ANIM/CUTS are read directly

limits.title: IMG directory entries (all archives)
limits.advice: There is no shared pool of raw IMG entries. Check each resource-type store and entry format separately.

limits.title: Largest IMG entry
limits.ref: SA IMG VER2 directory uint16 streaming-size field
limits.advice: Split or shrink the asset; an INI pool setting cannot widen the IMG on-disk field.

limits.title: Map placements (all IPLs)
limits.ref: Text and binary IPL inst arrays; streamed blocks are not simultaneously resident
limits.advice: Inventory only; compare resident building/dummy demand, not this total, with entity pools.

limits.title: Largest text IPL inst array
limits.ref: CFileLoader IPL resort buffer; CrashInfo entry 305
limits.advice: Split the text IPL or configure the adjuster's IPL resort limit. Binary streamed IPLs do not use this text buffer.

limits.title: Text IPL entity index arrays
limits.ref: CIplStore::IplEntityIndexArrays; allocated for text IPLs with instances

limits.title: IPL entry-exit markers
limits.advice: DFF effects and scripts can create additional entry-exits at runtime.

limits.title: Car-generator records across all IPLs
limits.ref: Text and binary IPL cars arrays; streamed generators are removed with their IPL
limits.advice: Inventory only; these generators are not all resident at once.

limits.title: Map pickups
limits.advice: Scripts create additional pickups at runtime; reserve room beyond the IPL count.

limits.title: Collision records in effective COL files and DFFs
limits.ref: COL records and embedded DFF collision extensions
limits.advice: Inventory includes unbound and duplicate records; the collision-model pool counts bound model objects.

limits.title: Loaded vehicle structures
limits.advice: One per resident vehicle model, not one per registered vehicle IDE line.

limits.title: Streaming DFF + TXD memory
limits.advice: The estimate uses texture.budget sector accounting. Add runtime room for COL, IFP, scripts and actors.

limits.title: DFF + TXD bytes across all model definitions
limits.advice: Inventory only; the engine streams a working set, not every model at once.

limits.title: Path region slots (highest region + 1)
limits.advice: Extending the map also requires coordinated path-grid and world-boundary patches.

limits.title: Path nodes across all regions
limits.advice: Inventory only; each path region owns its arrays.

limits.title: Largest path-node array in one region
limits.ref: CNodeAddress uint16 node index; 0xFFFF is invalid
limits.advice: Repartition paths; widening the on-disk node address is not a pool INI change.

limits.title: Largest navigation-link array in one region
limits.ref: SA compact path format: packed 6-bit area and 10-bit navi address
limits.advice: Repartition paths or use a compatible extended path format; a pool INI change is insufficient.

limits.title: Largest traffic car group
limits.advice: Reduce the group or configure fastman92's cargrp expansion; check interactions with loaded-vehicle settings.

limits.title: Largest requested car group (before stock reader truncation)
limits.ref: CPopulation::LoadCarGroups; the stock loader reads at most 23 names per group
limits.advice: To use additional names, configure fastman92's cargrp expansion; the stock game ignores the excess.

limits.title: Vehicle upgrade lists
limits.ref: carmods.dat mods section; one list per named vehicle model

limits.title: Largest upgrade list on a vehicle
limits.advice: Keep at most 18 compatible upgrades per vehicle; no verified per-vehicle-array INI mapping.

limits.title: Standard handling records
limits.advice: New names need fastman92's handling.cfg patch even when the record count fits.

limits.title: Weapon information records (including skill variants)
limits.advice: Additional weapon types require fastman92's weapon-type loader, not only the Weapon Models limit.

limits.title: Weapon types named in weapon.dat
limits.advice: Custom weapon names require the weapon-type loader even below this count.

limits.title: Timecycle entries (23 weathers x 8 hours)
limits.advice: The stock reader uses 184 entries. A 24-hour timecycle needs a compatible timecycle plugin, not a generic pool raise.

limits.title: Desired loaded vehicle models
limits.advice: This is a streaming target, distinct from live vehicles and vehicle structures; traffic and scripts determine demand.

limits.title: Invisible entities retained by the renderer
Resident animation hierarchies
limits.advice: Resident animation banks and cutscenes determine the peak; all installed animations are not simultaneous.

limits.title: IMG files across all namespaces
limits.ref: satk.formats.layout archives; ANIM/CUTS included as file inventory
limits.advice: Only main and player archives consume CStreaming::ms_files slots.

limits.title: Effective TXD files across all namespaces
limits.ref: Winning files per streaming, loose and special namespace
limits.advice: Clothing dictionaries are combined by CClothesBuilder, rather than one ordinary TXD slot per texture file.
